metadata.case_name: POON CHI KWONG v. POON WING KEE (METAL WORK) AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: casual light and sedentary work with Chuen Tat Construction Company

injuries.description: fracture of the first lumbar vertebra
source: he was later diagnosed to have suffered multiple fractures to his left knee, right ankle, right thighbone, as well as the first and third lumbar vertebrae.
The lumbar fractures were treated with bed rest for nine weeks, then a rigid corset for two to three weeks which was then replaced with soft corset for one to two months.
In his report, Dr Au stated that there was a gibbus at L1 level of the lumbar spine. There was pounding over the mid lumbar spine and spinal movement was limited.
According to D Au, the impairment is permanent and the plaintiff will have on and off exacerbation of his back pain with exertion.

injuries.description: fracture of the third lumbar vertebra
source: he was later diagnosed to have suffered multiple fractures to his left knee, right ankle, right thighbone, as well as the first and third lumbar vertebrae.
The lumbar fractures were treated with bed rest for nine weeks, then a rigid corset for two to three weeks which was then replaced with soft corset for one to two months.

injuries.description: fracture of the right thighbone (right femur)
source: he was later diagnosed to have suffered multiple fractures to his left knee, right ankle, right thighbone, as well as the first and third lumbar vertebrae.
Open reduction and Russel Taylor Nailing was performed for the fractured right femur

injuries.description: fracture of the left knee (left tibial plateau and fibula involvement described)
source: he was later diagnosed to have suffered multiple fractures to his left knee, right ankle, right thighbone, as well as the first and third lumbar vertebrae.
external fixation was performed for the left tibial plateau and fibula on 4 January 2002.

In his report, Dr Au stated ... the left knee joint movement was limited. There was tenderness over medial and lateral facets of the left patello-femoral joint with significant crepitation on bending of the left knee. There was no laxity of the left knee ligaments.

injuries.description: fracture of the right ankle (right medial malleolus / pilon crack fracture referenced)
source: he was later diagnosed to have suffered multiple fractures to his left knee, right ankle, right thighbone, as well as the first and third lumbar vertebrae.
Open reduction and internal fixation were performed for the right medial malleolus on 30 January 2002.
the fractures in the lumbar vertebra and the right pilon crack fracture were treated conservatively.
Dr Lau ... The plaintiff has residual pain in his back. There was also residual pain and stiffness of the left knee, as well as the right ankle.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: lost consciousness until he woke up again in hospital
left knee pain and stiffness; limited left knee joint movement; tenderness over medial and lateral facets of the left patello-femoral joint with significant crepitation on bending
back pain with on and off exacerbation on exertion; gibbus at L1; pounding over the mid lumbar spine; spinal movement limited
limited joint movement (left knee and right ankle)

treatments_received: Open reduction and Russel Taylor Nailing for fractured right femur (4 January 2002)
external fixation for the left tibial plateau and fibula (4 January 2002)
Open reduction and internal fixation for the right medial malleolus (30 January 2002)
conservative treatment for lumbar fractures (bed rest nine weeks, rigid corset 2-3 weeks, soft corset 1-2 months)

losses.description: Residual pain and stiffness in the back, left knee and right ankle; recurrent exacerbations of back pain; reduced joint movement and crepitation
Unable to resume pre-accident work as a welder; tried various jobs but could not hold any due to disabilities; reduced earning capacity
